name: zion-armor-outpost
description: Zion Armor Outpost - a comic Bible bookstore built on the MERN stack

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run server" "npm run client"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
